headline: Quiet streak continues as earlier boosts wear off
body: Another day without scored news. Earlier announcements continued to fade, shaving 0.01 off Gatekeeper and Reversion, while the world factors drifted by hundredths. Without fresh news, the slow fading of older stories is the only thing moving the lines. Horizon Balance edged to +1.95.
movers_note: Gatekeeper and Reversion each -0.01 from fading, both rounding to 0.0.
